prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1314; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left-hand turn. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person.

We ask that you provide the full liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also request that you disclose the name of the adjuster assigned to the claim and confirm the claim number in your response.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes vehicle data and telematics, photographs, dash camera footage, recorded statements, repair estimates, the vehicle itself where it remains in your control, and all internal claim notes and correspondence. Failure to preserve such material may expose your insured to sanctions.

We look forward to your prompt written response within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.
